answers.core: PopupMenu and the Control/Style system are part of the core engine. It would be nice to have out-of-the-box support for configuring these controls to highlight checked rows.
answers.workaround: There might be a way to work around this issue, but I think it would entail switching away from the built-in PopupMenu and OptionButton types, which would reduce the value and convenience of being able to use built-in controls/styling.

title: Add `Selected` StyleBox property to PopupMenu's Style
